title: Salvation by Faith
edition: Preached at Saint Mary's, Oxford, 18 June 1738. 1872 text checked against the forty-four sermons.
blurb: Rendered in modern English, to be read and heard. Open the 1872 text under each part to check the claims and the scripture.
era_note: John Wesley lived from 1703 to 1791. This sermon was preached in 1738. It is an English sermon, not an ante-Nicene father.

text_history.method: Rendered in modern English. The 1872 panel is the public-domain sermon. Its disputed lines were checked against the University of Toronto scan of the forty-four sermons: a public robber, a common harlot, sons of perdition, the Romish delusion, and Popery.
text_history.identifiers: Sermon 1. Saint Mary's, Oxford, 18 June 1738. Ephesians 2:8.
